diffuseAlbedo.source: Correlation between Colour Traits and Intrinsic Quality of Dalbergiae Odoriferae Lignum, Molecules 28(22), 7635 (2023), https://doi.org/10.3390/molecules28227635 (read at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10674628/), Table 1
diffuseAlbedo.note: Checked against the paper. Mean of 54 qualified D. odorifera heartwood samples (60 collected, Hainan, Guangdong and elsewhere): L* 44.59 ± 3.29 (38.98-52.91), a* 9.71 ± 1.65 (5.93-12.84), b* 9.44 ± 2.93 (3.83-16.88). HunterLab UltraScan VIS, D65, SCE. The paper does not state the observer, so the record's 'D65, 2 deg' space label is an assumption for this value. Measured on 40-mesh POWDER of medicinal-grade heartwood (降香), not on a planed or oiled face. It is the same species and the same tissue, but powder scatters more than a solid finished face, which will look darker and more saturated. Treat it as the species' measured anchor, not the colour of the finished table. It replaces the photograph-read (48, 14, 30): that b* of 30 is far outside the measured range of 3.8-16.9.

refractiveIndex.source: Marschner, S.R., Westin, S.H., Arbree, A. & Moon, J.T. (2005) Measuring and modeling the appearance of finished wood, ACM Transactions on Graphics 24(3) (as cited in the timber records)

porosity.source: Richter, H.G., Gembruch, K. & Koch, G. CITESwoodID: Dalbergia odorifera (Huanghuali), https://www.delta-intkey.com/citeswood/en/www/fabfaodo.htm ('Wood heavy and hard (0.93-0.97 g/cm3)'); cell-wall density 1500 kg/m3 (Siau 1995), as in the oak record
porosity.note: Checked against the source. CITESwoodID does not state the moisture content for its density. The Wood Database (Meier, https://www.wood-database.com/huanghuali/, opened) gives 875 kg/m3 average dried weight (SG 0.85 basic, 0.88 at 12 % MC), which would give 0.42. Range 0.35-0.42.
porosity.derivation: 1 - 950 / 1500 = 0.367, where 950 kg/m3 is the middle of CITESwoodID's 930-970

wettingDepth.note: As the oak: the depth a finish soaks into.

grain.source: Richter, H.G., Gembruch, K. & Koch, G. CITESwoodID: Dalbergia odorifera (Huanghuali), https://www.delta-intkey.com/citeswood/en/www/fabfaodo.htm
grain.note: Confirmed. Diffuse-porous. Vessels 'small to medium to large (50-160-280 um)', so the mean tangential diameter is 160 um. Vessels are 'very few, or few (3-12)' per mm2.

bedAspect.note: How much coarser the figure is along the grain than across it.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness), as the oak's.

rayFleck.note: How much of a quarter-sawn face the rays show.
